idb_notes.comment: Raw ARM checked2026-10-28: New Game menu action plays confirm at0x1A0A8, calls StartUi_Shutdown here, then enters Geoscape_InitUI at0x1A0B8. StartUi_Shutdown calls Sound_Shutdown0x38D80 and KillTimers_B0x38D84 before later geoscape sample/track setup. Port's CLI/script New Game shortcuts previously called App_HookNewGame directly while startup UI was live, omitting this edge. They now reuse MenuCtl0_OnClick while g_bStartupUi is true, and retain direct hook when already closed. Native audio/device behavior remains unverified. Original trace/old note: docs/parity/startup-newgame-lifecycle-raw-2026-10-28.json.

Raw ARM checked2026-10-28: R7 preserves LoadGame incoming R0 at0x44BC8; this STR stores the zero-initialized/two-byte TACTVER value to slot-context+0x118. Direct load caller0x19E00 uses literal0x156938, also passed by Tact_InitMission at0x3D220/0x3D228/0x3D230. AllocFlobjs0x431C0 and ReadFlobjs0x43270 both read incoming context+0x118; ReadTGameData saves its context inR6 at0x4424C and forwards it at0x444AC. Thus field0x156A50 is a live count-width selector: zero=1byte, nonzero=4bytes. Earlier claims of write-only residue or Map+0x118 at0x113AD0 were false pointer-base interpretations. Port World body-reader flag now follows loaded nTactVerOut, matching allocation.
